explication: AGS is a scaffolding CLI for Astal/Gnim desktop-shell projects, alongside a GJS runtime library for GTK3/GTK4 applications. The documented starter flow is to use the CLI to scaffold a project and then run an application; command-level links are limited because the supplied excerpts do not show those implementations. The runtime excerpts show app startup, D-Bus control, compatibility patches, and process-backed polling. Other library exports are represented as capabilities without inferred call paths.
